![Mouseover Tooltip logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/master/.github/assets/logo.png)

# Mouseover Tooltip

[![BuyMeACoffee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pachadotdev/buymeacoffee-badges/main/bmc-donate-yellow.svg)](https://buymeacoffee.com/f0rty_tw0)

**The mouseover tooltip you already know, with the info you actually want, and nothing that slows your game down.**

![Player tooltip with item level, the mount they ride and where to get it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/master/.github/assets/tooltip-mount-source.png)

## Why players install it

- **See what matters at a glance.** Item level, Mythic+ rating and best key, the mount they're riding, who they're targeting.
- **Quest mobs tell you what's left.** "6/10 Boar slain (4 left)", finished objectives in green.
- **It stays out of the way.** Blizzard's tooltip look, no extra frames, no libraries. Disabled options do no work at all.
- **Hide tooltips in combat** and hold Shift when you do want one.

![NPC tooltip in the Blizzard look, with lines from another addon kept in place](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/master/.github/assets/npc-tooltip.png)

Plays nice with other addons: the lines on the right come from AllTheThings.

## Settings

Options > AddOns > Mouseover Tooltip, or type `/mot`. Every line can be turned on or off. The panel's **Defaults** button resets everything.

The minimap button opens the same panel; drag it to move it around the minimap.

![All Mouseover Tooltip settings on one page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/master/.github/assets/settings.png)

## Game versions

Retail, Classic Era, TBC, Wrath, Cata, Mists Classic and WoW: Forever. Features a game version doesn't have (Mythic+, PvP rating, some inspect data) are hidden there.

## Performance

- No per-frame updates: the tooltip follows the cursor using the game's own anchoring.
- Other players are inspected at most once every 1.5 seconds, and results are kept for 5 minutes (up to 100 players, never saved to disk).
- Events are listened to only while they are needed.

# Changelog

Player-friendly release notes for Mouseover Tooltip. This file covers the current 1.x series; older series live in [archive/changelog/](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/blob/master/archive/changelog).

All releases: **1.1.x (current)** · [1.0.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.0.md) · [0.1.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/MouseOverTooltip/blob/master/archive/changelog/0.1.md)

## [Unreleased]

## [1.1.5] - 2026-11-21

- Fixed: possible Lua errors in combat when a player's item level and spec finished loading mid-fight. In combat, they now show the next time you hover that player.
- Fixed: "Skip inspect in combat" now also stops an inspect started just before the pull.

## [1.1.4] - 2026-11-18

- Fixed: item level, spec and PvP rating could stop loading for the rest of the session after a player's details failed to arrive, until you reloaded the UI.

## [1.1.3] - 2026-11-15

- Fixed: with "Hide unit frames in combat" on, hovering your player or party frame in combat still showed the tooltip.

## [1.1.2] - 2026-11-13

- Fixed: after hovering a player, spell and talent tooltips could cut their description short with "..." instead of wrapping onto more lines.
- Fixed: the Mythic+ rating could stay missing for players outside your group when item level, spec and PvP rating were all turned off.

## [1.1.1] - 2026-11-12

- Fixed: a long mount source (where the mount comes from) could stretch the tooltip very wide instead of wrapping onto more lines.

## [1.1.0] - 2026-11-10

- Fixed: with health text on, hovering someone in Mythic+ right after hovering a party or target frame could show that frame's health numbers instead.
